readings.enrolled: Everyone on the books this year, across the four class years.
readings.applicants: Who applied: the market's interest, scaled by prestige, reputation, beauty and the sticker against the market's.
readings.admitted: How many the office let in: the pool times the admit rate the selectivity sets.
readings.yield: The share of the admitted who come. It falls as the sticker rises and rises with the reputation.
readings.classSize: The class that results, capped by the beds and the triples allowance.
readings.quality: Mean applicant quality of the admitted, 0–100; a selective office skims the top of the pool.
readings.tuition: The sticker: what every enrolled student is billed, before aid.
readings.netTuition: What a student actually pays after the standing aid discount.
readings.selectivity: The share of the pool turned away; the admit rate is what is left.
readings.revenue: The class's gross tuition next year, before aid.
readings.beds: Beds in open residence halls and Founders Hall; students beyond them live in triples.
readings.meals: Dining seats in open halls; a crowded refectory costs satisfaction.
readings.seats: Teaching seats in open halls; crowded classes cost satisfaction.
readings.triples: Students living three to a room because the beds ran out.
readings.satisfaction: How the class rates the place, 0–100: housing, dining, seats and the state of the buildings, for now.
readings.attrition: The share of every cohort that leaves each year at this satisfaction.
readings.cohortSize: Students in the class this year.
readings.cohortQuality: The class's quality, 0–100: as admitted, then drifting each year toward the teaching it gets.
readings.teachingQuality: Program quality averaged over the open programs: what the cohorts learn from.
readings.base: Where every class starts before the campus and the year have their say.
readings.housing: Lost to triples: the share of students beyond the beds.
readings.dining: Lost to the crowded refectory: the share beyond the dining seats.
readings.seatsTerm: Lost to crowded classes: the share beyond the teaching seats.
readings.condition: The state of the buildings: full condition costs nothing, ruin costs the most.
readings.teachingTerm: Program quality against the neutral line: nothing to study is the worst of it.
readings.morale: What the faculty's quirks add or take, capped.
readings.placement: Everything the layout is worth to their mood — campus beauty and the buildings that stand near their partners — added up and capped.
readings.conditions: Living through the ladder: a freeze, austerity and receivership cost more each.
readings.distinguished: Graduates who left with distinction: the class's score above the middle earns them.
readings.placed: Graduates who went on, unremarkably, as most do.
readings.adrift: Graduates who drifted: a base, rising as the class's score falls below the middle.
readings.outcomeScore: The class's score: quality weighted seven to three against how it left.
readings.campusBeauty: Campus beauty, 0–100: greenery, landmarks and upkeep, weighted; it moves the applicant pool a little and the cohorts' mood.
readings.greenery: Trees standing against the founding woodland: fell them for buildings and it falls, plant and it climbs.
readings.landmarks: The buildings that are something to look at, by their marks in the catalogue, against a full set.
readings.upkeep: The open buildings' mean condition: backlog is ugly.
readings.lifeTerm: What the student centre, the health centre, the recreation centre and the fields are worth to the students: full when between them they reach everyone, a share when they reach a share.
readings.eventsTerm: What the last few events left the students feeling. It fades over a couple of years.
readings.reputation: What families say about the place, 0–100. Once a year, at Commencement, it moves part of the way towards what the college's students are getting. Above 50 it grows the applicant pool and the yield; below 50 it shrinks them.
readings.reputationReading: What this year gives them to say: the four causes below, weighted. The reputation moves towards it at the next Commencement.
readings.reputationPool: How much the reputation is moving the applicant pool, before price, prestige and the layout.
readings.repTeaching: The teaching the students are getting now. It counts most.
readings.repSatisfaction: How the enrolled classes rate the place.
readings.repOutcomes: How the last four classes turned out: distinguished graduates count in full, placed graduates count for three fifths.
readings.repCondition: The state of the buildings the students live and learn in.
readings.expectationsTerm: What they were promised. A famous college is judged harder, and so is one whose price is above the market's. A bargain is forgiven a little.
readings.returnsTerm: Near the top, every point is harder to win: above 80, each further point counts for less than half a point.

words.noClass: No class yet. The first arrives at Convocation, after Admissions Day.
words.capped: The beds being what they are, the file closes early: {size} of {wanted} who would come.
words.triplesWarning: {triples} of them will live in triples.
words.nextClass: The {label} would graduate today with {distinguished} distinguished, {placed} placed and {adrift} adrift.
words.housingAhead: Next spring's admissions file will close at about {cap}: the {beds} beds that will stand when that class arrives, with triples, less the classes still here. This year's class is {size}.
words.housingShort: That is fewer than this year. A residence hall takes {weeks} weeks and sleeps {hallBeds}; ground broken before Admissions Day is counted.
words.reputationQuiet: Nobody has graduated yet, so there is nobody to talk. A new college is taken at its word.
